rationale: The price has reclaimed the 195.00 psychological level and is showing signs of consolidation above it, invalidating the immediate bearish momentum thesis. With the price approaching the 9-EMA ($195.28) and the invalidation level ($195.35) at risk, the risk-to-reward profile of the short position has deteriorated significantly. Closing now preserves capital and avoids a stop-out as the stock attempts to stabilize.
